routing_warnings.description: This message establishes a minimum number of approved videos that must be posted, rather than changing the recurring monthly clip-production quota.
The instruction concerns carrying a lesson through to completion rather than selecting a substantively valuable source moment.
The observed failure concerns lessons being cut off halfway; the same message also contains duration evidence for REQ_CLIP_DURATION.
The seven rejected clips are criticized for weak or insufficiently impactful moment selection, not for narrative incompleteness.
The black text shadow correction concerns caption effects rather than narrative completeness.
The wind-noise correction concerns source audio cleanliness rather than narrative completeness.
The remaining correction explicitly changes caption placement and should also be represented under that Requirement.
The new refusal to approve clips under 70 seconds changes the independently measurable duration Requirement.
The separate shorter-clip-styles clause may change the permitted clip-duration behavior.
The hook-training clause concerns identifying strong hooks and may provide evidence for the hook-quality Requirement.
The black text-shadow correction concerns caption effects rather than general clean visual editing.
The wind-noise correction concerns source-audio cleanliness.
The remaining correction explicitly concerns fixed caption placement.
The instruction to match the reference lettering concerns the brand-compliant caption font rather than caption color or effects.
The remaining correction explicitly concerns keeping caption text fixed in one screen position.
The black text-shadow correction concerns caption effects rather than font selection.
The instruction to keep text fixed in one position concerns caption placement rather than font selection.
The requested clarification between @ardenvalevideo and @ardenvaleofficial follows the post-caption and in-post tagging instructions and is better routed to post metadata and attribution.
The roughly 4-5 clips per day statement describes production output needed to reach the monthly approved-clip target, not Instagram publication cadence.
The authorization to post one approved clip concerns the publishing approval gate and does not independently change the one-per-day rollout cadence.

The report that only one clip was delivered by the one-month mark concerns delivery performance; it does not establish how many approved clips were posted or whether the Instagram publication window was followed.

missing_requirement_candidates.description: The client separately requests that the published Reel link be sent directly after posting, and the freelancer supplies it. This does not establish that the required date and link were recorded on the designated Notion card.
